matches.description: Watch Bayern München vs Bodo/Glimt highlights and goals from UEFA Champions League on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on September 10, 2026. On 2026-09-10 , the UEFA Champions League spotlight turned to the Allianz Arena as Bayern München hosted the Norwegian challengers Bodo/Glimt . With 75,000 fans creating an electric atmosphere, the stage was set for a night of high-intensity European football where clinical finishing would eventually define the outcome. A Test of Patience in the Opening Period The match began with Bayern München asserting their typical dominance, controlling 66% of the possession and pinning Bodo/Glimt into their own half. Early on, Luis Diaz forced a save from Nikita Haikin with a sharp header, signaling the home side's intent. However, despite numerous corners delivered by Michael Olise and Joshua Kimmich , the breakthrough remained elusive. The Norwegian visitors defended gallantly, frustrating the Bavarian giants and limiting their clear-cut chances. Bodo/Glimt looked for opportunities on the break, with Andreas Helmersen testing the waters from distance, but his efforts lacked the accuracy to trouble the Bayern goal. As the referee blew for half-time, the score remained level, with the visitors feeling confident about their defensive organization while the hosts sought a spark of creativity. The Floodgates Open After the Break That spark arrived immediately after the restart. In the 47th minute, Harry Kane turned provider for Jamal Musiala , who smashed a brilliant volley into the net to open the scoring. The momentum shifted drastically, and in the 61st minute, Harry Kane went from creator to finisher, heading home a precise cross from Michael Olise to double the lead. The tactical substitutions made by both managers around the 80th minute did little to slow the Bayern juggernaut. Alphonso Davies added a third in the 77th minute with a thunderous left-footed volley that left the goalkeeper with no chance. Bayern were now in full flow, moving the ball with confidence and precision, while the visitors struggled to keep pace with the relentless attacking waves of the German side. Olise’s Masterclass and Late Drama The final ten minutes belonged to Michael Olise , who delivered a performance worthy of the Man of the Match title. In the 83rd minute, he unleashed a stunning strike from outside the box following a pass from Lennart Karl , a goal already being discussed as a contender for the season's best. Bodo/Glimt ’s evening went from bad to worse in the 87th minute when Odin Luraas Bjortuft was shown a straight red card for a professional foul as the last man. Capitalizing on the numerical advantage, Bayern added a fifth goal in stoppage time. Michael Olise found the net again in the 90+2 minute with a composed left-footed finish. It was a statement victory for Bayern München , whose second-half explosion ensured a dominant start to their continental campaign.

After an active start to the match, the Bavarian giants refused to let up their intensity as the game progressed. The scoring onslaught in the second half began in earnest in the 50th minute when M. The fluidity of Bayern's play was evident in every transition. In the 56th minute, J. Palhinha added his name to the scoresheet to bring the tally to 0-9. Shortly after, in the 59th minute, A. matches.title: Bayern Munich vs Stuttgart
matches.description: Watch Bayern München vs Stuttgart highlights and goals from Bundesliga on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 28, 2026. The Allianz Arena set the stage for a high-stakes Bundesliga clash as Bayern Munich hosted VfB Stuttgart on August 28, 2026. With 75,024 fans in attendance, the atmosphere was electric as both sides looked to secure a statement victory in the early stages of the campaign. Bayern Take the Initiative Bayern Munich established dominance early on, dictating the tempo through their midfield maestros. The pressure told in the 21st minute when Joshua Kimmich delivered a pin-point corner from the left. Dayot Upamecano timed his jump perfectly to power a header past the goalkeeper, giving the hosts a deserved lead. While Stuttgart attempted to claw their way back, with Grischa Prömel testing the defense, Bayern remained composed to head into the break with a narrow 1-0 advantage. A Dramatic Second-Half Turn The game exploded into life shortly after the restart. In the 52nd minute, Josha Vagnoman stunned the home crowd by volleying home an equalizer for VfB Stuttgart . However, the parity lasted just three minutes. Michael Olise restored Bayern 's lead with a clinical left-footed finish, once again assisted by the ever-reliable Kimmich . The momentum shifted entirely in favor of the hosts when Vagnoman 's afternoon took a turn for the worse, scoring an own goal in the 58th minute to make it 3-1. Closing Out a Convincing Win Despite having a goal ruled out by VAR for offside in the 64th minute, Bayern continued to pour forward. The introduction of fresh legs from the bench, including Ismael Saibari , proved decisive. In the 82nd minute, Aleksandar Pavlović tapped in from close range after a brilliant setup by Saibari and Olise . The rout was completed in stoppage time when Luis Díaz found the back of the net with a precise right-footed strike. The final whistle confirmed a dominant 5-1 victory for Bayern Munich , with Upamecano earning plaudits for a standout performance.
